info.name: Star Wars REST API (SWAPI) Films API

description.content:
The Star Wars REST API (swapi.info) is the world's first quantified and programmatically-accessible data source for all the data from the Star Wars canon universe. It provides structured JSON access to films, characters (people), starships, vehicles, planets, and species. No authentication is required.

Contact Support:
 Name: SWAPI
